# Incidence questions yield a common relational refinement

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For locally finite, incidence-connected declared scopes with equal root answers, all equally answering fragment pairs form a common refinement whose projections cover those scopes, preserve joins and lift joins fixing one participant.

Canonical source: [Joining.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Joining.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Two partial ternary joining laws J and K, possibly on different fragment types; the same finite branch language over six role movements.
- Finitely many incident joins per fragment/role; Related roots and ConnectedFrom on both sides.

Incidence nodes carry actual J or K witnesses; graph paths inspect relations and are not automatically temporal executions.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 checks 43 new declarations and 213 inherited audits, 256 total; new 9 empty and 34 standard dependency lists, 7 with classical choice. Frozen source/logs bind to the receipt; no independent-agent acceptance.

Only one participant is fixed; fixed-pair lifting does not follow. The unanchored language collapses for local-unit structures. This proves neither identical actual provenance nor universal ontology.

Boundary source: [EXPLANATORY-JOINING-CONTEXTS-INTEGRATION.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-JOINING-CONTEXTS-INTEGRATION.md)

The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Two joinings with alike roots, from which every fragment is reached, have a common refinement, the joining of their alike pairs, whose two projections are open and cover both, with no finiteness and no decision (Joining.common_refinement); under the periphery's hypotheses, local finiteness and roots passing the same tests, with excluded middle, so do they (Joining.common_refinement_of_em).
